summary: Nez Perce NF steel tower and log cabin built 1931 in Idaho County; tower gone by 1968; cabin moved to Grangeville Park in 1961 or the 1970s.

facts.design: Steel tower with a log cabin for living quarters
facts.status_note: Tower gone by 1968 per firelookout.com; the log cabin was moved to Grangeville Park. No source describes the mountain site now.

visit.trail_note: No source describes access to the mountain site now. The Idaho Fire Lookouts label 'Drive-Up Cabin Moved' appears to refer to the cabin.

events.note: Steel tower with log cabin built in 1931. Height 75 ft on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page and the forest index; 90 ft on firelookout.com.
Cabin moved to Grangeville Park in 1961 per the Idaho Fire Lookouts page; firelookout.com says the 1970s.
Tower gone by 1968 per firelookout.com. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page gives 'Gone by 1968' for a patrol point 3 miles SW at Goose Creek Point.

corrections.why: The forest index lists Fish Creek under its IDAHO COUNTY heading. Idaho is the state, not the county.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives a 90-foot tower; the Idaho Fire Lookouts page and the forest index give 75 feet. The record keeps 22.9 m (75 ft), the figure two sources agree on.
1961 on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page; the 1970s on firelookout.com. The relocation event uses 1961, the earlier date, and the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Three sources, no staffing or fire records found. Height and cabin-move year conflict; both are reported. A LandmarkHunter search result says the cabin went to Grangeville Lions Park in the 1970s, but that page timed out and is not cited. The cabin's current condition is unverified.
